⚠️ BREAKING NEWS with fresh tears:

Permit ng mga DDS sa EDSA People Power Monument rally is cancelled AND denied with FINALITY!

Natapos na ang INC rally kahapon kaya it just makes logical sense na wala na din dapat na EDSA rally today.

Andaming nag reklamo kahapon na sobrang traffic at sobrang perwisyo ang EDSA rally ng mga DDS eh 300 to 4,000 people lang naman dumating.

Buti sana kung naabot nyo 1,000,000 eh di pwede nyo sabihin sulit yung road closure.

Pero wala nilangaw na naman so what’s the use?

Day 1 eh 4,000 people max lang ang crowd estimate. Day 2 eh 2,000 to 3,000 people max.

So kung pinayagan kayo mag Day 3 ngayon baka 1,000 people or less na lang kayo AND YET kinakain nyo yung malaking portion ng EDSA and White Plains Avenue??!

Itigil na ang kahibangan na yan.

Walang regime change na mangyayari.

Iyak mga ka-DDS!

#EDSA
#TrillionPesoMarch

UPI RALLY RELOCATED

LOOK: The United People's Initiative, a group of protesters led by retired military officials, move their rally to a shopping mall along EDSA-Ortigas Avenue in Quezon City on Tuesday, Nov. 18.

The UPI said the Quezon City government denied its permit application to continue its rally at the People Power Monument. The group's three-day rally was supposed to end on Tuesday.
